title: ShareNet 2.0 Routing Protocol Schemas (FROZEN per spec/07 §5)
description: Canonical machine-readable schema definitions for the routing protocol objects. Shared by spec/07-routing.md, the reference implementation, conformance tests, and vector generation. Any change to this file MUST be accompanied by a corresponding change to spec/07-routing.md and the TypeScript implementation.

linkUp.description: MUST be true for committed routes

agreementDigest.description: hex of BLAKE3-256 of negotiated terms

RouteProposal.forbidden_note: routeId is NOT in the proposal — the only route identity is commitment_root (R-003/R-004 final reconciliation)

SignedRouteProposal.description: The canonical signed wire object carrying a RouteProposal and its source signature.

signature.description: Ed25519 by source over the proposal signing payload

SignedRouteProposal.signature_payload_note: domain || canonicalEncode(proposal_fields) — integer-keyed CBOR map per ADR-0004, excluding routeId

proposalDigestHex.description: hex of BLAKE3-256 of canonical RouteProposal

hopIndex.description: which hop this acceptance is for

hopDigestHex.description: hex of BLAKE3-256 of canonical HopDescriptor

serviceDigestHex.description: hex of BLAKE3-256 of canonical ServiceAgreement

RouteAcceptance.signature_payload_note: domain || proposal_digest || hop_index || hop_digest || service_digest || acceptor_node_id || nonce || expiry

commitmentNonce.description: fresh per commitment (in signature only, not in Merkle tree)

committerSignature.description: Ed25519 by source over commitment_root + commitment_nonce

RouteCommitment.signature_payload_note: domain || commitment_root (32 bytes) || commitment_nonce (16 bytes) per spec/07 §5.3.2

merkle_algorithm.nonce_inclusion: NOT in Merkle tree — only in source signature (§5.3.2)
